comment.narrative: 2.1.a Year 2 Results Based Budgeting systems applied in seven selected countries

Belize Guidance on how to use the national conservation trust fund funding more effectively was developed and is being implementedBhutan A draft Resource Allocation Formula has been sent to the government to ensure that adequate financial resources are apportioned to biodiversity at local levelBotswana A resultsbased budgeting manual was developed to support the Department of Wildlife and National Parks staff. A resultsbased budgeting roadmap for Botswana was also developed with a currently draft awaiting approval by government.Indonesia Ongoing migration of the work of biodiversity expenditure assessment from a manual into an the government online performancebased budgeting systemKyrgyzstan Revision of budgeting rules that define the principles of public financing for Protected AreasMadagascar Working on Improving budget formulation and budget execution procedures of the Ministry of Environment at central and regional level
